title: Art. 50 — Montreal Convention 1999, Chapter VI - Other Provisions, Article 50 — Insurance
content: States Parties shall require their carriers to maintain adequate insurance covering their liability under this Convention. A carrier may be required by the State Party into which it operates to furnish evidence that it maintains adequate insurance covering its liability under this Convention.
